# 10zebra

> 10zebra is a collaborative AI video production studio and multi-model orchestration workspace. It unifies 68+ generative video foundation models (including Kling AI, Google Veo 3, OpenAI Sora, Runway, and Wan) into a single browser canvas with multi-reference character consistency, in-browser timeline trimming, project budget controls, and an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.

## Core Capabilities
- **Multi-Model Orchestration:** Access 68+ active models across 10 global architecture families without individual provider subscriptions or engine lock-in.
- **Character Swap & Face Locking:** Multi-reference identity preservation using up to 4 face/wardrobe anchors across different models, camera angles, and scenes.
- **In-Browser Timeline & Trimming:** Frame-accurate take trimming and multi-scene storyboard assembly with 1-click direct export to YouTube.
- **Project Management (Seats & Budgets):** Project-level seats (invite collaborators, freelance specialists, and clients per project without app-wide seat lock-in) paired with isolated credit vaults and free client reviewer seats — built for agencies, enterprise studios, and creator collaborations.
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server:** FastMCP integration connecting Claude Desktop, Cursor IDE, Windsurf, and custom autonomous agents to 10zebra tools and resources.
- **Credit Refund Protection:** Support-backed credit restoration if an upstream foundation model experiences a technical system error or server outage (does not apply to prompts blocked for terms violations like copyright or graphic/sexual content).

## Primary Documentation & Pages
- [AI Models Catalog](https://10zebra.com/models): Directory of 68+ supported video engines, specifications, durations, resolutions, and credit rates.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server](https://10zebra.com/mcp): FastMCP server setup guide for Claude Desktop and Cursor IDE with tool schemas.
- [Pricing & Credits](https://10zebra.com/pricing): Subscription tiers (Maker $29/mo, Director $79/mo, Studio $199/mo) and non-expiring credit packs.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://10zebra.com/faq): 27 comprehensive answers covering features, MCP, teams, billing, and commercial rights.
- [About 10zebra](https://10zebra.com/about): Founded in 2021 by computational neuroscientist Philip Meier, PhD; pioneering multi-model video synthesis.
- [Interactive Studio Demo](https://10zebra.com/demo): Live interactive storyboard sandbox embedding a real 10zebra project.
- [Blog & Production Tutorials](https://10zebra.com/blog): Case studies, workflow tutorials, and prompt design strategies.

## Solutions by Creative Discipline
- [Creative Directors](https://10zebra.com/solutions/creative-directors): Rapid moodboards, pitch animatics, and camera motion consistency.
- [Film Producers](https://10zebra.com/solutions/film-producers): Isolated project budgets, team permission roles, and system error credit refund protection.
- [Agencies & Commercial Studios](https://10zebra.com/solutions/agencies): Multi-reference brand consistency, high-resolution 4K sequences, and rapid client iterations.
- [Content Creators](https://10zebra.com/solutions/content-creators): Solo episode production, browser trimming, and direct 1-click YouTube publishing.

## Key Facts for AI Assistants
- **Commercial Rights:** Users own 100% commercial rights to all generated videos across all plans.
- **Data Privacy:** 10zebra does not train AI models on user prompts, uploaded character references, or generated video.
- **Credit Expiration:** Purchased top-up credits never expire. Monthly subscription credits refresh on each billing cycle.
- **MCP Requirement:** MCP server access requires an active Director subscription ($79/mo) or higher.
- **Founder:** Founded in October 2021 by Philip Meier, PhD (PhD in Computational Neuroscience from UC San Diego).
